premise: The last dragon rider, bonded to the only dragon still alive.

draft.premise: The last dragon rider, bonded to the only dragon still alive.

world.title: The Last Embers
world.era: A medieval age of castles, iron-clad armies, and fading wonders.

extraordinary.kind: dragon bonding and elemental fire magic
extraordinary.reach: Enables telepathic connection, shared senses, and channeling of draconic fire.
Massive ancient beasts capable of flight, devastating fire breath, and deep magical affinity.

rules.text: Only one living dragon remains in the entire world, hidden in the mountain sanctuary.
The bond between a rider and a dragon is an indissoluble spiritual tie that links their minds and lifespans.
Human magic cannot exist or be sustained without the presence of active dragon life force.

peoples.name: Humans
peoples.culture: The dominant inhabitants of the kingdoms below, split between fear of the old magic and desire to control it.

creatures.name: Dragon
creatures.description: Ancient, intelligent scaly beasts of monumental power and elemental fire.
creatures.habitat: High volcanic peaks and remote mountain sanctuaries

rungs.name: Acolyte
rungs.description: A newly bonded companion learning the first echoes of the mental link.

rungs.name: Fledged Rider
rungs.description: The bond is locked; rider and dragon can fly as one and share thoughts seamlessly.

rungs.name: Dragon Warden
rungs.description: A veteran champion capable of channeling dragonfire directly through their own weapons.

rungs.name: Dragonlord
rungs.description: An absolute master of the bond, commanding the elements and living for centuries.

travel.description: By foot, horse, or wagon along winding mountain paths; only a dragon can cross the peaks in minutes.

medicine.healing: Herbal poultices and rare restorative elixirs brewed using dragon scales.

laws.text: All dragons and those who aid them are declared enemies of the state, to be executed on sight.

places.name: Oakhaven Valley
places.description: A quiet farming community nestled at the foot of the jagged Wyrmtooth mountains.

places.name: Crag Pass
places.description: A narrow, windswept mountain gorge prone to sudden rockslides and freezing winds.

places.name: The Draconic Sanctuary
places.description: An ancient, cavernous stone cathedral carved into the peak, once a haven for dozens of riders.

places.name: Peak of Shadows
places.description: The treacherous, mist-shrouded summit of the Wyrmtooth range.

factions.name: The Iron Inquisition
factions.description: A ruthless order of zealots dedicated to cleansing the world of dragons and magical influence.

factions.name: The Kingdom of Solaria
factions.description: A prosperous feudal state that officially sanctions the Inquisition to keep peace.

npcs.name: Vermyth
npcs.description: The last living dragon. His dark scales are scarred from ancient battles, and his yellow eyes hold weary wisdom.
npcs.appearance: A colossal dragon of obsidian scales, soot-stained wings, and a massive crown of horns.

wants: To live out his remaining centuries in peace.

npcs.name: Grand Inquisitor Garrick
npcs.description: A stern, silver-haired inquisitor who views the eradication of dragons as a holy calling.
npcs.appearance: Tall and spare, dressed in dark steel-plated armor and a heavy crimson cloak.

wants: To slay Vermyth and parade his head in the capital.

clocks.name: The Inquisition's Ascent
steps: Inquisition scouts gather at the base of Crag Pass.
Inquisition soldiers breach the mountain's lower tree line.
Garrick's force surrounds the Sanctuary's gates.

threads.title: Escape the Inquisition
threads.stakes: The survival of the last dragon rider and the last living dragon.

mysteries.question: What truly wiped out all the other dragons so quickly?
mysteries.answer: The Crown and the Inquisition poisoned the high mountain streams with concentrated moon-leaf extract, targeting the dragons' nesting grounds directly.
clues: A rusted royal vial smelling of withered moon-leaf found near a dried-up nesting spring.
An old ledger in the Sanctuary detailing how the mountain waters suddenly turned toxic decades ago.

known_facts: The Inquisition has chased you to the edge of the Wyrmtooth range.
Vermyth is the last surviving dragon of the old world.

opening.situation: As heavy snow beats against the high stone archways, Vermyth stirs beside you, his low growl warning that hunters have entered the mountain pass below.

world.summary: You are the last dragon rider, bonded to the only dragon left alive. Hidden high in the mountains, you must survive a ruthless Inquisition closing in on your sanctuary.

character.name: Kaelen
character.description: A young rider with a look of fierce quiet determination and eyes that burn with the heat of the hearth.
character.appearance: Lean, athletic build, windblown dark hair, clad in scarred leather riding gear reinforced with blackened scales.

traits.name: Dragon-Bonded
traits.description: Your spirit is intimately tied to Vermyth, letting you share his sensations and call on his power.

traits.name: Hunted
traits.description: Your existence is an affront to the realm's laws, drawing zealots and hunters wherever you go.

powers.name: Mind Link
limits: Range is limited to a few miles unless concentration is absolute

powers.name: Dragonfire Spark
limits: Requires Vermyth to be alive and active
Can only ignite small fires or heat metal on your person

items.name: Rider's Blade
items.description: A well-balanced steel sword with a pommel carved in the shape of a roaring dragon.

items.name: Saddlebag
items.description: A sturdy leather bag containing dried meat, a waterskin, and mountain maps.

connections.name: Vermyth
connections.note: The last living dragon and your soul-bound companion.
